_comment: PLANNED CONFIGURATION — run 'uip maestro flow node configure InvoiceProcessing.flow newInvoiceInSharepoint1 --detail "$(cat newInvoiceInSharepoint1.detail.json | python3 -c import sys,json,d=json.load(sys.stdin);del d["_comment"];print(json.dumps(d))')' once IT provisions the SharePoint connection.
_open_questions: connectionId: IT must create a 'Microsoft OneDrive & SharePoint' connection in Integration Service and supply its UUID
folderKey: The Orchestrator folder key (UUID) for the folder that owns the connection
driveId: The SharePoint site drive ID — IT can retrieve from the SharePoint site URL
folderId: The item ID of the 'New Vendor' folder within the drive
